name: Sorrow Integration
description: Glimmer betting, roulette (solo + multiplayer rooms), daily and weekly challenges, and Globed support - all connected to the Sorrow Discord bot.

bet-bar-effects.name: Bet Progress Bar Effects
bet-bar-effects.description: Golden progress bar effects that build up as you get closer to the percent you bet on.

screen-effects.name: Screen Effects
screen-effects.description: Screen glows and shakes when you win or lose a bet.

show-hud.name: Show HUD
show-hud.description: Display the roulette HUD (target percent, deaths, best, Glimmer) while a session is active.

group-auto-join.name: Group Auto-Join
group-auto-join.description: When a Globed room-mate starts a Sorrow group roulette, join it automatically.

report-deaths.name: Report Deaths
report-deaths.description: Send your deaths (level, percent, attempt number) to the bridge for /gd stats. Practice and cheated runs are never reported.

max-skips.name: Number of skips
max-skips.description: The maximum amount of skips allowed during a round of the roulette.

hide-goal-reached.name: Hide Goal Reached
hide-goal-reached.description: Hide the 'Goal Reached!' popup after a short while after reaching the goal.

use-big-button.name: Use big button
use-big-button.description: Use a big button rather than the small circle button. Only works with Pages API installed.

roulette-button.name: Roulette entry button
roulette-button.description: Show the roulette button on the creator page (solo roulette + multiplayer rooms).
